user.title: Connect to What's Up Docker
user.description: Enter the connection details for your WUD instance.

data_description.url: Base URL of your WUD instance, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:3000 or https://wud.example.com
data_description.name: A friendly name to identify this WUD instance and prefix its entities, e.g. Home Server
data_description.auth_method: Match this to how your WUD server is secured (WUD_AUTH_*). Choose Anonymous when no authentication is configured.
data_description.verify_ssl: Disable when using a self-signed certificate behind a reverse proxy
data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll WUD for container updates (minimum 60 s)

basic.title: HTTP Basic authentication
basic.description: Enter the username and password configured for WUD Basic auth.

bearer.title: Bearer token
bearer.description: Paste a long-lived access/API token. It is sent as an 'Authorization: Bearer' header.

data_description.token: A static token that your identity provider or reverse proxy accepts for the WUD API.

oidc.title: OpenID Connect (client credentials)
oidc.description: Configure a service-account / client-credentials client (e.g. Authentik, Authelia, Keycloak). The integration fetches and refreshes access tokens automatically.

data_description.oidc_discovery_url: The .well-known/openid-configuration URL of your identity provider's realm/application.
data_description.oidc_scope: Space-separated scopes requested for the access token (default: openid).

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate with What's Up Docker
reauth_confirm.description: Credentials for {url} are no longer valid. Enter new credentials.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to WUD. Check the URL and that WUD is running.
error.invalid_auth: Authentication failed. Check the credentials for the selected method.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant logs.

abort.already_configured: This WUD instance is already configured.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll WUD for container updates (minimum 60 s)
data_description.max_concurrent_updates: Maximum number of containers that can be updated at the same time. Set to 0 for no limit. When the limit is reached, additional updates are queued.
data_description.auto_update_time: Default time of day at which automatic updates are applied when a container is set to 'Integration Update Time'
